description: One link that stands in for all of them. A reviewer with no GitHub account and no CMS access lands here and sees every current preview, grouped by collection — and it stays current by construction, since a preview minted after the link was shared appears without re-sharing anything. Opt-in: the page exists only because settings.json carries a previewIndexToken, and rotating that token is the revoke. Unguessable is not secret — anyone holding this URL can read every preview on it.
